integrity: Exact algebraic proof, explicit eigenvalue normalization, and a replayable finite-field incidence checker included.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to 3-subspaces and \(n\ge6\); independent mathematical verification is not performed; finite checker only corroborates, and historical priority may be affected by an unindexed general Grassmann positivity result.
title: Exponential collapse of negative type for rank-three finite Grassmann graphs
